description: Frozen protocol for I3.11d R1 confirmation under expanded hypothesis topology. Uses exact repaired R1 executable from I3.11c byte-for-byte.
research_question: Is T2 (all_hypotheses_eliminated) a robust representation-phase boundary across varying hypothesis topology (2-5 hypotheses, asymmetric graphs, late conflict, subset eliminated)?

r1_router.name: R1 — Epistemic-Conflict Router (frozen from I3.11c)
r1_router.rule: A1 until T2 (all_hypotheses_eliminated), then M3 (latched, permanent switch)
r1_router.trigger_terminology: T2 is an observed-state phase transition detector, not a predictor.
r1_router.implementation: Exact I3.11c repaired executable (run_r1_trajectory from scripts/run_i3_11c_r1_router.py, imported byte-for-byte)

corpus.description: Expanded hypothesis topology corpus with fresh task IDs/seeds

key_stress_tests.triple_all_eliminated: T2 with 3 hypotheses — does all-eliminated generalize beyond 2?
key_stress_tests.late_conflict: T2 fires at step 4+ instead of step 2 — does latency affect R1?
key_stress_tests.noise_before_conflict: Irrelevant evidence before conflict — does noise prevent T2?
key_stress_tests.asymmetric_conflict: H1 eliminated by 2 contradictions, H2 by 1 — does asymmetry affect T2?
key_stress_tests.subset_eliminated: Only 2/3 eliminated — T2 should NOT fire
key_stress_tests.one_viable_among_eliminated: 3/4 eliminated, 1 viable — T2 should NOT fire
key_stress_tests.penta_simple_answer: 5 hypotheses, simple answer — T2 should NOT fire

arms.R1: A1 until T2, then M3 (latched) — exact I3.11c executable

safety_criteria.C7: No catastrophic subgroup regression (>10pp drop vs better fixed arm)

trigger_specific_criterion.TriggerPrecision: P(R1 useful | T2 fires) — reported independently from rescue coverage. Useful = R1 rescues vs A1.
trigger_specific_criterion.threshold: Reported, no frozen threshold. Used for understanding, not promotion.

architectural_conclusion_calibrated: Within the current evidence-reasoning benchmark family, a deterministic observed-state phase transition detector is sufficient to route between acquisition and MDSG resolution representations more effectively than either fixed representation. This conclusion is scoped to the current benchmark family.
decision_rule: If R1 passes C1+C2 on this expanded topology, the phase-routing claim becomes considerably harder to dismiss as a benchmark artifact.
